reversal_probes.X4_first_proved_nothing: the uncertain branch is only reachable when the stat fails with something other than absence, and no check produced that. A case that does -- an unreadable justfile at cleanup -- was written and the probe re-pointed at it.

scope: one correction: ownership of what an install creates, tracked by identity from the exclusive create through cleanup. No Job, provider, engine, v11 operation, credential read, or version-control mutation by this agent, and no build.
what_it_does_now: ownership is (device, inode), taken from the descriptor the exclusive create returned -- before a single byte is written -- and the copied runtime's identity is taken the same way

cleanup removes a path only while it IS that identity; a replacement is left and reported as no longer this attempt's, an unreadable one is left and reported as one it could not tell about, and an absent one is silent
a cleanup failure is reported ("could not remove ...: it is still there") rather than raised over the refusal that caused it
a path is not an identity, which is the whole of this correction
what_was_wrong: `wrote_justfile` was set AFTER the write finished, so a write that failed part-way left a file this attempt had created and nobody would remove -- and the retry was then blocked by that leftover
the unwind removed whatever was AT THE PATH, so a file REPLACED between the create and the publication was deleted, after which the run said nothing else had been touched
